article.title: 日本精工以音樂及機械動作重塑工業品牌形象
article.summary: 日本精工NSK發布由水曜日的康帕內拉主唱詩羽出演的電視廣告，傳達解決方案夥伴定位。
highlights: 企業廣告主題為MOTION is SOLUTION。
原創樂曲與使用NSK產品的裝置動作同步。
article.why: 工業品牌可用看得見的產品動作，讓抽象定位在創意中有具體依據。
article.next_step: 選一個能示範的核心技術，先用短片把它和品牌想解決的問題連起來。
article.detail: NSK把MOTION is SOLUTION用於新一輪企業廣告，傳達從軸承製造商走向為工業及社會解決問題的夥伴。新電視廣告由詩羽出演，原創歌曲與裝有NSK產品的裝置動作配合。工業品牌可參考這種安排，讓受眾先從具體產品動作理解新的企業定位。樂曲以滾動、碰撞及反彈等動作為創作題材。
article.title_en: Japan's NSK uses music and machinery to refresh its industrial brand
article.summary_en: NSK unveiled a TV ad starring Utaha of Wednesday Campanella to communicate its positioning as a solutions partner.
highlights_en: The corporate campaign uses the theme MOTION is SOLUTION.
The original song is synchronized with the movements of devices using NSK products.
article.why_en: Industrial brands can use visible product movements to make abstract positioning tangible.
article.next_step_en: Choose one demonstrable technology and connect it to the problem your brand wants to solve in a short clip.
article.detail_en: NSK is using MOTION is SOLUTION in corporate advertising to communicate its evolution from bearing maker to a partner solving industrial and social problems. The TV commercial stars Utaha and pairs an original song with the movements of equipment using NSK products. Industrial brands can apply the idea by making visible product behavior the starting point for new positioning. The composition draws on motions such as rolling, collision and rebound.
